I'm now switching to the stateful approach, using `chat.sendMessage` for cleaner chat history management. I've re-examined the documentation and determined this is the most direct integration. I will continue with the UI improvements requested to make the app more similar to a React Native app. I'm going to add a navigation drawer and update the header and side menus.
